kind: editor's request: Issues-FS and Email-FS as folders in git; finishing

plan.comment: 1. In scope: comms/issues and comms/mail folders in the vaults' layout; board and mail pages built from them (admin/build/**); CLAUDE.md, WAKE.md (finishing rule: a member pauses its own task, records it), ONBOARDING.md, vaults.json, REALITY.md, schedule.json (round the clock); a notice to each member's mailroom; the conductor's own comms paths (comms/README.md, its board, mail and posts; not comms/** whole, which would overlap). 2. Outside scope, at the editor's 01:58 UTC word: each member's policy.json (its own comms paths only) and a Done when list in each ROLE.md. 3. Never create or edit another member's task.

pre_review.comment: Proportionate if the editor's 01:58 word is as stated. Conditions: other members' policy.json and ROLE.md changed only to add their own comms paths and a Done when list, each named in the commit; comms scopes disjoint, gate before any push; vault_check on comms/ (public: no keys, contact details or vault keys); finishing pauses only one's own task; round the clock creates no task; no em-dashes.
